index.title: Connect a Personal Assistant to Manage Tasks and Schedule Appointments
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Connect Personal. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Connect a Personal Assistant to Manage Tasks and Schedule Appointments. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result.
index.what_happened_excerpt: The user connected their calendar and online services to a personal assistant, which was used to schedule appointments and manage tasks.
